name: spi_i2c
description: hardware_spi and hardware_i2c against the catalog's EEPROMs. SPI0 (mode 0, spi_init's 125 MHz / (2 * 32) = 1953125 Hz) to a 25LC040, its CS a GPIO: WREN sets its latch (status 02), WRITE of six bytes, RDSR polled through its 5 ms write cycle, READ returns them, spi_write_blocking leaves it idle and drained; 1099 bytes in all, 16 SCK edges each. I2C0 (i2c_init's 125 MHz / 313 = 399361 Hz, 4.7 kOhm pull-ups) to a 24C02 at 0x50: a six-byte i2c_write_blocking, address-only writes NACKed through its write cycle, a current-address read, a random read (a write without STOP, then a read after a repeated START), and 0x51 unanswered (PICO_ERROR_GENERIC); 2634 SCL edges, every START, byte and STOP of it.

expect.contains:
spi: 1953125 Hz
spi: status 02 after WREN, write cycle over after 538 polls, read RP2040
spi: busy 0, readable 0 after spi_write_blocking

i2c: 399361 Hz
i2c: wrote 6
i2c: ready again after 5100 us (114 NACKs)

i2c: current 1 S
i2c: random 4 DK24
